description: End the session: write the handoff summary and post the project update, with a `title` and `summary` for your teammates. Procedure: session.md.

body.description: Filled session-wrap template; sections are enforced

health.description: Omit to wrap without posting a project update

notes.description: Legacy spelling of `summary`; `summary` wins when both are sent

repo.description: Workspace repo to target. Defaults to the current repo, or the first repo at a multi-repo root.

summary.description: 2-3 plain sentences for a teammate: what changed and what it means. Prose, not a log

title.description: One line for a teammate: what this session did. E.g. "Landed the Activity week view over live data"
